en.headline: Environment secretary heads to Beijing for APEC energy ministers’ meeting
en.dek: Tse Chin-wan will also meet officials from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and the National Energy Administration during the five-day visit.
body: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan departed for Beijing on Monday afternoon to attend the APEC Energy Ministers’ Meeting and the Asia-Pacific Energy Sustainable Development High-level Forum later this week.

During the trip he will meet officials from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment to discuss Hong Kong’s progress towards carbon neutrality, green living and the green transition. He will also hold talks with the National Energy Administration, visit facilities of State Grid Corporation of China, and meet Customs officials on cooperation.

The APEC meetings on Thursday and Friday will cover energy collaboration, high-quality energy services and the role of artificial intelligence in energy. Tse is due to return on Friday evening; Under Secretary for Environment and Ecology Miss Diane Wong will act in his place while he is away.

zh.headline: 謝展寰赴京出席APEC能源部長會議
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長今午啓程，期間將與生態環境部及國家能源局官員會面，周五返港。
body: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰周一下午啓程前往北京，將出席亞太經合組織能源部長會議及亞太能源可持續發展高端論壇。
行程中他將與生態環境部官員會面，就香港邁向碳中和、推動綠色生活及綠色轉型的工作進展作深入交流；亦會與國家能源局官員會面，參觀國家電網設施，以及與海關總署官員討論加強合作。
會議於周四及周五舉行，討論範疇包括亞太能源協同共治、高質量能源服務，以及人工智能與能源等。謝展寰預計周五晚上返港，期間由副局長黃淑嫻署任。
